emergingSignals.signal: AI infrastructure made tangible without replacing the page

emergingSignals.portfolioFit: Type and a horizon rule as the tangible instrument. No WebGL education game.

emergingSignals.signal: Motion declared in markup, last-frame reduced-motion
emergingSignals.whyItMatters: Art-directed launches encode scroll timelines in markup and treat reduced-motion as instant last-frame composition.
emergingSignals.characteristics: Data-attribute timelines, fake-3D type via delayed duplicate, intersection-gated loops. Extract primitives; reject Walkman nav.
emergingSignals.portfolioFit: One CSS scroll-driven horizon-rule extension. Instant bearing under prefers-reduced-motion.

emergingSignals.whyItMatters: After last week's zinc drafting sheet, the field is cooler and more atmospheric while staying two-color.
emergingSignals.characteristics: Glacier paper, polar ink, one cyan course mark. Reject cream, rust terracotta, neon product green, blueprint navy.
emergingSignals.portfolioFit: Glacier vapor + polar ink + deep horizon cyan.
